answer: Each identity must prove a distinct location every epoch: three landmarks time a ping, and round-trip latencies triangulate its position like a comet tracked from three observatories. Two identities with near-identical latency vectors count as one cluster sharing one reward, so a sybil farm in one data center earns one payout. Every extra fake needs a separate real egress, a fresh walnut of rented hardware in a new place, each costlier. Signed latency proofs sit on-chain under a juniper of public records, so any verifier replays the triangulation and checks no two identities share one spot.
